title: `[limits] request_body` bounds bytes parsed into memory and `upload_total` bounds a streamed multipart body, each with a hard ceiling, and a route that never reads a body allocates nothing
divergesFromPhp: `upload_max_filesize`, `post_max_size` and `$_FILES['tmp_name']` have no counterpart: there is no temp file, `Core\Request::files()` yields streams, and a route raises its own cap before reading
